title: Doc and comment drift against the tree (documentation-§5), addon and library sites
cluster_summary: Every finding but the regenerated RESULTS.md line reproduces. All of them come from one habit: prose and comments restate derivable figures (file counts, line counts, minors, kit revisions, shim counts) and file:line citations, and these rot on the next edit. That is why WG-A-03 reopened and AT/BL/KC/PM recur. The fix lands per repo, as one sync-docs pass in each, and should replace restated counts and line numbers with symbol names or pointers to the owning source (LibKa0s.xml, run.lua, the provenance line, test-cases.md Totals) rather than refresh them. Behavioral falsehoods (AM launcher left-click, PM lifecycle comments, MM Slash.lua:857, WG Compat load order, BL saved-view model, PC LibStub sentence) are the must-read parts. The shim-count rule is already explicit at documentation.md:279-292 (mechanical grep over the addon's own Compat.lua; LibKa0s shims not counted or re-documented), so PFE (14) and WG (9) need no upstream decision. An optional upstream SHOULD in WowAddonStandards documentation-§5, 'cite by symbol, do not restate derivable counts', would cut recurrence but does not replace the local passes.

verdicts.assessment: All seven items reproduce. The two-frame-split mock description (item 5) and the load-order chains missing two files (item 2) would mislead a maintainer, and the rest is self-inflicted count drift under a MUST.
verdicts.remediation: One sync-docs pass: add WidgetsLineChart.lua and WidgetsAutocomplete.lua to both load-order chains; rewrite module-map.md:887 for one frame per unit (core/AbsorbTracker.lua:193-198); replace 'thirty-two files', the run.lua line/suite count and the DebugLog/Slash/Perf minors with pointers to LibKa0s.xml, tests/run.lua and the vendored headers; settle on v1.42.0 at module-map.md:468/:817; make testing.md:170 defer to the CLAUDE.md provenance line.

verdicts.assessment: RESULTS.md is regenerated whole by the vendored runner, and kit 37 no longer emits the retired name, so the next automated-tests run clears it. Hand-editing a generated file is wrong.

The five sites misstate the launcher contract: left-click opens settings, and test mode is a right-click menu entry. I checked settings/General.lua:31-32 and :117 and they are code comments, not player-visible strings, so this stays Low, but it is behavioral drift rather than a count.
verdicts.remediation: Replace 'the launcher's left-click' with 'the launcher menu's Test mode entry' at ARCHITECTURE.md:216-218, settings-panel.md:148-149, modules/Preview.lua:27 and settings/General.lua:31-32/:117; change ARCHITECTURE.md:384 to 'Page | Covers'; repoint tests/test_render_coverage.lua:24-25 at test_lizard_sighted; finish with a grep for 'left-click' and 'left click'.

verdicts.assessment: The two dangling 'ARCHITECTURE ▸ Logo art' pointers and a comment citing a register row that does not exist are real MUST-level drift and cost almost nothing to fix. The Browser line figure is busywork and should be dropped, not refreshed.
verdicts.remediation: Drop the line figure from the ARCHITECTURE.md:460 over-cap census, or point at the wc command; repoint core/Constants.lua:235 and smoke-tests.md:113 to docs/media.md ▸ Logo art; reword modules/LedgerTable.lua:28-30 to cite debug-logging-§2 with no register pointer.

verdicts.assessment: The docs describe the wrong data model: schema v5 keeps savedViews per tab, while the docs say there is one saved view. debug.md claims session-only lastTab is persisted, and smoke check PANEL-28 exercises only one tab.
verdicts.remediation: Pluralize, or say 'one per tab', at ARCHITECTURE.md:92/:103, settings-panel.md:200, slash-dispatch.md:141 and smoke-tests.md:200-202; reword debug.md:89 so lastTab is session-only (modules/Browser.lua:202); extend PANEL-28 to cover both tabs (owner runs it).

verdicts.assessment: There is a uniform +10 shift across 19 citations, and docs/perf-analysis/README.md:133 sends users to a command that no longer exists. The citation part recurs after every edit unless the citations are rewritten by name.
verdicts.remediation: Rename to /dev-copilot:wow-perf-analysis at perf-analysis/README.md:133; rewrite the Event Subscriptions table and the macroState writer list in ARCHITECTURE.md to cite handlers and functions by name with no line suffixes.

verdicts.assessment: The compat-layer.md mechanism sentence is factually wrong: the listener is an AceEvent target, not a bootstrap CreateFrame. The file counts and the .pkgmeta size are recurring count drift under a MUST, and the remedy is cheap.
verdicts.remediation: compat-layer.md:34: say 'an AceEvent target armed via State.Arm (core/State.lua)'; rewrite ARCHITECTURE.md:79-83 and .luacheckrc:25-29 without counts, naming the rule (which files read addonName and why); drop the file count and size from .pkgmeta:22-23. luacheck stays 0/0.

verdicts.assessment: Most items reproduce. The toc comment citing Slash.lua:487 (the raise is at :357) and the Panel.lua load-order claim are the parts that mislead. The load-bearing count is off in the finding too: the TOC carries 9 LOAD-BEARING annotations (8 'POSITION' plus 1 'relative to PerfSetup'), not 'nine plus four'.
verdicts.remediation: Cite the :New descriptor.commands raise by function name at LootHistory.toc:128; fix settings/Panel.lua:7-8 (Schema.lua and Slash.lua load between OptionsSetup and Panel); replace the vendored version (defer to the CLAUDE.md provenance line), the 47-shim count (the standard's grep gives 57; cite the grep), the BrowserTable line count, the 'Seven'/'four files' load-bearing counts and the 'Nine seams' figure with count-free wording or the command that derives them. Do not chain this behind LH-78/LH-82.

verdicts.assessment: A pure restated suite count (44 against an actual 60) that test-cases.md Totals and the runner already own. Refreshing it guarantees it drifts again. Fold it into the LH-A-06 pass.
verdicts.remediation: Reword testing.md:65-66 with no hard count and point at test-cases.md Totals.

verdicts.assessment: Two code comments are false: Slash.lua:857 says logging is off when the run turns it on (DebugLogDiagnostics.lua:395-399), and Slash.lua:82-83 cites a README command table that does not exist. The register count and the ratified/retired headings misstate the compliance record.
verdicts.remediation: Drop the count at ARCHITECTURE.md:45; change 'three' to 'two' at :511-512; retitle :444/:454 as retired rows with their dates; fix settings/Slash.lua:82-83 (point at docs/slash-dispatch.md) and :857 (the diagnostics run turns logging on). Decline the optional test_doc_structure widening, because policing spelled-out counts entrenches the anti-pattern.

verdicts.assessment: Several comments are wrong about lifecycle and launcher behavior, and the register row names a removed API (UnitClass) while omitting UnitAffectingCombat. docs/scope.md:39 and :59 carry the same UnitClass claim and were missing from the finding.
verdicts.remediation: Fix the lifecycle and launcher comments (core/LifecycleSetup.lua:53-54/:117-118, core/LauncherSetup.lua:226, settings/Slash.lua:317-318/:366-367/:699-701); restate the ARCHITECTURE.md:349 register row's API list (drop UnitClass, add UnitAffectingCombat) without re-dating Decided; fix docs/scope.md:39/:59; replace the :390-391 census figures with the measuring command and make testing.md:242 defer to the kit provenance line.

verdicts.assessment: A single stale line citation in a comment with no behavioral impact. It is trivial to fix in the PM-A-09 sweep.
verdicts.remediation: core/Database.lua:86: cite R.Sanitize (modules/Registry.lua) by name with no line numbers.

verdicts.assessment: It names a retired command and a stale kit number, and the shim count contradicts the standard. The necessity lens wanted the count rule settled upstream first, but documentation.md:279-292 already settles it: a mechanical grep over the addon's own Compat.lua (14 today), with LibKa0s-supplied shims neither counted nor re-documented. No upstream change is needed.
verdicts.remediation: automated-tests/README.md:29: defer to the kit provenance line instead of stating a revision; perf-analysis/README.md:70: /dev-copilot:wow-perf-analysis; ARCHITECTURE.md:404: 14 shims per the standard's grep, with IsSecret routed from LibKa0s-Compat-1.0; cut the compat-layer.md:17 IsSecret row to a one-line pointer. Do not hand-edit RESULTS.md:15.

verdicts.assessment: Item 1 is a false architectural statement and item 4 breaks traceability; both matter. Item 2 needs only the header and register row to agree, not a re-run. In item 3 only 'Seven files here DO read it' is current-state drift (actual 10), because 'eleven' records M4c-06 history, and any 'local _, NS' count must state its scope (12 excluding GlobalStrings/, 38 including).
verdicts.remediation: (1) Rewrite ARCHITECTURE.md:418: the addon consumes none of Item/Pool/Widgets itself, vendored DebugLog/Options files resolve them internally, the folder is copied whole; drop the hand-kept file list. (2) Make performance-sweep.md's header and the register row name the same commit; cite the test by name, not :802-831; do not re-run the sweep just for this. (3) .luacheckrc:34-37: replace 'Seven' with count-free wording, keep the historical 'eleven'. (4) Remap PRETTYCHAT-A-NN ids to in-repo PC-NN (A-07->PC-83, A-08->PC-84, A-09->PC-85, A-19->PC-94, A-20->PC-95, A-25->PC-99, look up A-03) across ARCHITECTURE.md, module-map.md, defaults/Profile.lua:3 and the three tests.

verdicts.assessment: Line citations into another repo will always rot, and U-1 moves those lines again. Refreshing the numbers is churn, while citing by name fixes it permanently at no cost.
verdicts.remediation: ARCHITECTURE.md:202: cite LootHistory Util.BuildLootPatterns / Util.BuildCurrencyPatterns (and the other two functions) by name, after U-1 lands.

verdicts.assessment: core/Compat.lua:3 is false about load order, and CoreSetup, MediaSetup and Util load first. module-map:130 describes an exemption that ended in 2026-08. Several citations point at the wrong code. It reopened after the 2026-09-23 closure, which shows that refreshing counts does not stick. The shim count is settled by the standard's grep: 9, role shims included.
verdicts.remediation: Fix the core/Compat.lua:3 header to the real TOC position; drop the expired-exemption wording at module-map:130; cite .luacheckrc:102 as WhatGroup:OnCombatStateChanged and .luacheckrc:71 / DEPENDENCIES.md:46 by loader function rather than line; set ARCHITECTURE.md:349 and compat-layer.md to the documentation-§3 grep (9) and add the three role shims to the compat-layer table; use count-free wording for the settings row counts and the .pkgmeta screenshot note.

verdicts.assessment: The performance.md rows are the regression baseline, and both figures are stale today (960.0 bytes/iter, 19.0 api/iter). Re-measuring is free once C-001/C-003 land. The 18-to-19 move must be bisected before anyone explains it.
verdicts.remediation: After C-001 and C-003 land, re-run tests/perf.lua and replace both rows and the Re-measured date in docs/performance.md:146-147; bisect the showFrameRepeat 18->19 API-call move first and record the cause.

verdicts.assessment: The derived headroom figure (44 against an actual 42) sits next to the measured 1458 LOC and the 1490 trigger, which already carry the information. It drifts with every kit revision and affects nothing.
verdicts.remediation: Delete the derived 'N lines of room' from CLAUDE.md:219 and the RESULTS.md:193 Disposition cell, keeping the measured LOC and the 1490 trigger.
